title: Marketplace, Partner Network, Professional Services

kcs.statement: AWS Marketplace is a curated digital catalog of third-party software, data and services from independent software vendors that you can buy and deploy, with charges on your AWS bill.

The AWS Partner Network includes partners that build software on AWS (independent software vendors) and partners that help customers design, migrate and run workloads (system integrators and consulting partners).
AWS Professional Services is AWS's own paid team of experts that works alongside customers and partners on large outcomes such as data-center migrations.

problem_ideas: A company wants a pre-configured third-party firewall AMI billed through AWS: where does it buy it?
A business needs an outside firm to run its whole migration: which kind of partner?
A software vendor wants to sell its SaaS product to AWS customers: which two programs apply?
An enterprise wants AWS's own consultants on a large modernization: name the offering.
Classify: Datadog, Accenture, AWS Professional Services, a Marketplace AMI.
Spot the false statement: 'AWS Marketplace purchases need a separate invoice from each vendor.'
